system.description:
Myrgha Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Rare, Rot. 1 item slot (Quickdraw). Attunement. Uses: 6.

Prerequisites: Nimble Hands: Roguecraft[1]

A small, well-worn lockpick set, handed down to you from a weirdly supportive parent.

Master Lockpick (Passive): When you have these lockpicks equipped in both hands and use Nimble Hands: Roguecraft to pick a lock, if you fail to pick a nonmagical lock you may expend one use of the lockpick to succeed instead. When all 6 uses are expended, these lockpicks break.

Rulebook p.35.
